Scenario fixture: duplicate-id

Targets use ids of the form dupid_case_NN — deliberately repeated where the case is about a duplicate. Ids are scoped per document tree and per shadow tree, and a shadow root cannot be built from static markup, so that branch lives in the rule's own tests rather than here.

A. Unique ids

01 — PASS: each id used once
Name
City

B. Repeated ids

02 — FAIL: the same id on two elements
Name
City
03 — FAIL: the same id on three elements
One Two Three
04 — FAIL: duplicate where one copy is not rendered (counted, and reported on the copy in scope)
Hidden Visible

C. Nothing to compare

05 — NEUTRAL: empty id value, out of scope
No id value
06 — NEUTRAL: no id attribute at all
Nothing to check

End of fixture.
